findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This is the only call site that loads every locale in the fallback chain. Translations invoked outside an `ApplicationController` request—such as mailers or background jobs running under a user's locale—go through the lazy loader, which loads only the active locale. The fallback backend then cannot find translations in the site-default or English locale, so the new fallback behavior silently fails in those contexts.

findings.title: Changing the site locale leaves cached fallback translations stale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on the current `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation accelerator caches results using only the key, active locale, and backend. If an administrator changes the default locale, translations already cached for users with another locale can continue returning values from the old fallback locale until the cache is cleared or those entries are evicted.
